intent: Define, without implementation, an OpenSpec product contract and source matrix for a framework-agnostic grouped Bar Chart capability derived conservatively from Dashboard.svg.

provenance.ref: The user accepted stable category.id and series.id identities.
The user accepted grouped bars with one through four series.
The user accepted equivalent tooltip disclosure for pointer hover and keyboard focus with roving arrow-key navigation.
The user accepted toggle-button legend controls that keep at least one series visible.
The user accepted an adjacent expandable semantic table alternative.
The user accepted a minimum plot width with horizontal overflow on narrow containers.
The user accepted consumer-owned filters and period controls that pass prepared chart data into the capability.
AGENTS.md makes shlz-design-source/raw/svg/Dashboard.svg the primary visual authority; the existing reporting dashboard ledger records unresolved chart regions.
AGENTS.md requires framework-agnostic core styles and interactive web behavior, with framework adapters remaining optional.
The user explicitly requested implementation: реализуй
